text: Been on hold earlier and gave up so trying this instead. Grandson, 7, staying with us. He won't settle to sleep tonight, keeps getting up. Temp was 37.7 last time I checked, I think, the thermometer's a bit old. His eczema's flared up again, dry itchy patches on his arms and behind his knees, and he's scratching at it. Otherwise he seems himself, wide awake, chatting away, watching telly. No fits or shaking or anything like that. Not sure if it's the itching keeping him up or the bit of temperature. Would appreciate a reply sometime tonight.
